simple: This page is about secrets: what players can see in your game, even things you think are hidden. Anything that gets sent to a player's device can be dug out by a cheater, including LocalScripts and ModuleScripts. Cheaters can also jump into other places in your game that you meant to lock. Knowing this helps you keep unreleased content and server code safe.
analogy: Sending something to a player's device is like mailing someone a locked diary. The lock looks nice, but once the diary is in their house, they can break it open. Truly secret stuff should never leave your own house (the server).
keyPoints: Cheaters can see everything that replicates to their device, even if it is invisible or unused.
Cheaters can decompile LocalScripts, client Scripts, and ModuleScripts that reach their device, even if they are disabled or never run.
Scripts in ServerScriptService and ServerStorage never go to players, so they cannot be decompiled.
Do not mix server code and client code in one ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage. Cheaters can read the server half, including any passwords.
If a player can join one place in your universe, they can try to teleport to any other place in it. Turning off "Direct Access" only hides the Join button.
Kicking players from a secret place is too late: content starts copying to them as soon as they join.
Best fix: in the Creator Dashboard, set Access Control for Places to "Secure within universe only", so only the server can teleport players into subplaces.
Keep test and unreleased content in a separate private universe, and do not use super obvious names for important remotes and scripts.

terms.replicate: To copy something from the server to players' devices. Anything that replicates can be seen by a cheater.
terms.replication container: A top-level service, like ReplicatedStorage or Workspace, whose contents get copied to every player.
terms.decompile: To turn compiled script data back into readable code.
terms.universe: Your whole game, which can include a main place plus extra places (subplaces) players teleport between.
terms.subplace: An extra place in your universe that is not the start place, like a lobby's separate arena.
terms.root place / start place: The place players land in when they first join your game.
terms.Direct Access: A setting that shows or hides the Join button for a subplace on the website. It does not stop teleports.
terms.secure teleport: A setting where only the server can send players to subplaces. Players cannot teleport there by themselves.
terms.streaming: Only sending the parts of the world near the player, instead of the whole map at once.
terms.server-authoritative: The server's version is the real one. Things must be created or changed on the server to show up for everyone.
terms.data-mine: Digging through game files to find hidden or unreleased content.
terms.production: The live, published version of your game that real players use.
terms.defense-in-depth: Using several layers of protection, so if one fails the others still help.

watchOut: Thinking a disabled LocalScript is hidden. If it is sent to the player, it can be read.
Putting a password or secret logic in a ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage. Keep it in ServerScriptService or ServerStorage.
Uploading unreleased items to your live game and hiding them. Cheaters will find and leak them.
Relying on kicks to protect secret places. Turn on "Secure within universe only" instead.
Letting players in when your check fails with an error. Default to not allowing them in.
